name: std::swap(std::basic_filebuf)
intro: Overloads the std::swap algorithm for std::basic_filebuf. Exchanges the state of lhs with that of rhs. Effectively calls lhs.swap(rhs).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
lhs, rhs

 -

 std::basic_filebuf objects whose states to swap

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Write and read a temporary file, then remove it. Public streambuf operations dispatch to filebuf's protected overflow, uflow, pbackfail, imbue, and sync functions.
